# Vector

Gives you one set of X, Y and Z values to share between nodes.

`lfs.vector` · Input

## How to use

Use for a common position, offset or direction.  
The default has all three coordinates at 0.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01 | X, Y and Z values in the units you need. The default (0, 0, 0) gives zero on every axis. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | — | — | Resulting X, Y and Z values, in the units of your calculation. |
